fee_notes: First store: $35,000 (included in development fee). Second and each subsequent store under DRR: $25,000, due within 5 days of opening. Development fee for minimum 5-store commitment is $75,000 ($35k first store + $10k each of stores 2-5; the $10k per-store is not credited toward future initial franchise fees). Transfer purchases pay no initial franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us a $35,000 initial franchise fee in a lump sum when you sign the Franchise Agreement for your first 7 BREW Store. The initial franchise fee for the 2nd and each subsequent 7 BREW Store you develop under a Development Rights Rider to the Franchise Agreement is $25,000.
